# zipboard-wp-design

Built design files for zipboard.co's WordPress site: compiled CSS, ES modules and
server-rendered HTML for the header, footer and pages. The zipBoard Design
WordPress plugin reads `manifest.json` from here and serves the assets from
jsDelivr, pinned to a commit.

**Do not edit by hand.** Everything here is generated by `wordpress/build.mjs`
in [zipboard-websitev2](https://github.com/pranab1981/zipboard-websitev2)
(`npm run publish:design`). This build: 80db3cb.
